content.user_title: Create Better Claude Code Plugin Skills
content.value_statement: Creating plugin skills requires clear triggers, structure, and reusable resources. This skill guides planning, writing, validation, and iteration for Claude Code skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains required SKILL.md frontmatter and body structure.
Shows how to organize references, examples, scripts, and assets.
Guides trigger phrase writing for reliable skill activation.
Provides validation checks for structure, writing style, and resource references.
Covers iterative improvement after real skill usage.
limitations: Does not create secure scripts automatically.
Does not validate files with an external linter by itself.
Requires user-provided domain examples for best results.
Focuses on Claude Code plugin skills, not every skill marketplace format.

use_cases.title: Build a Plugin Skill
use_cases.description: Plan a new skill with trigger phrases, reusable resources, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Refine Existing Guidance
use_cases.description: Move detailed material into references and keep SKILL.md focused.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Readiness
use_cases.description: Check structure, description quality, and progressive disclosure before release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a Claude Code plugin skill for [task]. Identify trigger phrases, required resources, and a short validation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Core Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a concise SKILL.md outline for [skill name]. Use third-person trigger wording and imperative body guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill draft for clarity, trigger quality, progressive disclosure, and missing resources: [paste content].

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Complex Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this large skill and propose a split between SKILL.md, references, examples, scripts, and assets: [paste structure].

output_examples.input: Create a skill for API schema review.
output_examples.output: A skill plan with trigger phrases, resource folders, validation checks, and examples to support repeatable reviews.

output_examples.input: My SKILL.md is more than 5,000 words.
output_examples.output: A refactoring plan that keeps core workflow in SKILL.md and moves detailed material into references.

output_examples.input: Check whether this plugin skill is ready.
output_examples.output: A readiness summary covering frontmatter, trigger phrases, writing style, resource links, and test prompts.

best_practices: Use concrete user phrases in the description so the skill activates at the right time.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed material into references.
Test with realistic prompts and update the skill after real use.
anti_patterns: Using vague descriptions that do not name specific tasks.
Putting every detail into SKILL.md instead of using progressive disclosure.
Adding scripts or examples without documenting when to use them.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create and improve Claude Code plugin skills with clear triggers, structure, and resource organization.

faq.question: Can it build a full plugin?
faq.answer: It focuses on skill content inside a plugin. It can guide related structure, but it is not a full plugin generator.

faq.question: Does it require scripts?
faq.answer: No. Scripts are optional and useful only when deterministic or repeated automation is needed.

faq.question: How should references be used?
faq.answer: Put detailed guides, schemas, and long examples in references so SKILL.md stays focused.

faq.question: Can Codex use this guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace report lists Codex support, and the guidance is useful for AI-assisted skill authoring.

faq.question: Is it suitable for non-technical users?
faq.answer: It is most useful for users who can describe the skill purpose and review Markdown instructions.
